title: Porsche 911

measurements.how_measured: estimated bounding box of car body versus full frame
measurements.statement: Silver convertible occupies the center diagonal from left edge to right-center, rear bumper near bottom third
measurements.value: car bounding box ~75% of frame width and ~65% of frame height, ~50% of frame area

measurements.how_measured: visual area estimate of near-black curtain, carpet and shadows versus lit car
measurements.statement: Right half and bottom are near-black curtain and carpet surrounding the lit car, lit from upper left
measurements.value: about 60% of frame is very dark; brightest highlight on left rear fender

measurements.how_measured: area estimate of saturated color patches versus frame
measurements.statement: Only two saturated hues: red taillights on rear and deep blue doors in far upper-left background
measurements.value: red ~4% of frame on rear; blue ~10% of frame in background

measurements.how_measured: compared letter height to frame height and described stroke and spacing by eye
measurements.statement: Rear badges RWB and PORSCHE plus plate ST2 22P are small sans with bold low-contrast strokes and tight spacing, black on silver and blue on white
measurements.value: each glyph height <2% of frame height, on right half of rear, image-dominant over text

measurements.how_measured: noted camera height relative to trunk and intrusions at frame edges
measurements.statement: Low rear three-quarter view just above trunk height, close crop with out-of-focus dark car part intruding at bottom-right and rail on far left
measurements.value: foreground blur ~25% of frame width in bottom-right; left rail hugs left edge

measurements.how_measured: compared surface sheen on body, wheels and fabrics by highlight behavior
measurements.statement: Matte low-gloss silver body with soft specular sweep contrasts matte black fabrics and highly reflective polished wheel lips on left third
measurements.value: body mid-gray with white highlight; wheels mirror-bright on ~5% of frame

hypotheses.statement: A bright matte-silver volume isolated against near-black surround creates single-subject hierarchy and premium nighttime-show mood.
Small saturated red taillights and distant blue doors act as color accents that anchor attention on the rear without competing with the car form.
Layered depth from blurred foreground intrusion to sharp car to receding blue hall gives diagonal rhythm and enclosure.
Tiny low-contrast badging keeps the image form-dominant, with text as texture rather than message.

relations.rule: Keep subject image >95% of visual weight; keep any lettering <2% frame height and confined to one quadrant of subject.
Restrict saturated color to <5% red focal accent plus <10% distant cool background accent, all else neutral.
relations.target: any neutral subject on dark ground

relations.rule: Limit palette to silvery neutrals + black plus at most two saturated hues, with darkness covering ~60% of frame.

fragile_if_changed: Brightening the black curtain and carpet surround to daylight levels would collapse the spotlight isolation that makes the silver body read as luminous.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'red taillights accent'
